'''Tehlan Aleece''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the niece of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Venram Krax]]. She was a long time agent for [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], using her connections to report vital information on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] procedures and activities. She fled [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] when she suspected her cover was about to be blown.

==Skills and abilities==
She was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]], [[Bothese]], and [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]]. She was an experienced [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] as well.<ref name="GoI" />
